newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Optus to launch Warner Bros channel.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Optus to launch Warner Bros channel.

text.p: Pay tv operator Optus Vision said on Tuesday that it has signed a exclusive agreement with Warner Bros International Television, a unit of Time-Warner Inc, for a general entertainment channel packaged for the local market.
"The channel will be available to subscribers from January 1997 and will be included in Optus Vision's sport, movie and deluxe packages," Optus Vision chief executive Geoffrey Cousins told reporters.
